_README: Searchable metadata catalog of the public Koshas-series resources — each with a short written summary for later discovery/search. Self-hosted under base_url. Companion to feedback/resources.json (which maps these to the form's Q3 rows). Generated for talks#88.

resources.title: Integrating the Five Koshas
resources.summary: Session 4 integration lesson deck (bilingual ES/EN + Sanskrit). Opening prayer (Saha Nāvavatu), the Mahāmṛtyuñjaya mantra and the koshic mantra map, and the practice of weaving all five sheaths into daily life.

resources.title: Kosha Cybernetics — Anatomy of a Living System
resources.summary: Re-engineers the koshas through cybernetics, neuroscience and systems theory: from the static nesting-doll model to multi-directional feedback cycles (a living, self-regulating system rather than layers you peel).

resources.title: Resonant Teaching Mastery — Sound, Mantra & the Teacher's Craft (Session 3)
resources.summary: Session 3 teaching deck (bilingual). Class flow — Kapalabhati wake-up, Shavasana stillness, guided rotation through the five koshas — framed as the teacher's craft of sound and mantra.

resources.title: Resonant Yoga Craft — De la Conexión a la Resonancia
resources.summary: The art of teaching yoga through sound and mantra; 'reading the space' — sensing the room's state (rajásico / sáttvico / tamásico) and returning the student to seeing, feeling, and self-observation.

resources.title: The Human Operating System — Del Modelo Clásico al Sistema de Control Vivo
resources.summary: Reframes the five koshas as interdependent subsystems of one living organism — not envelopes you peel off, but a dynamic integrated network (static model vs dynamic model).

resources.title: The Physics of Connection (Session 2)
resources.summary: Session 2 deck (bilingual): teaching through the sheaths, each kosha as a function — Annamaya = entropy/cohesion, Pranamaya = state-transition, Manomaya = attention, Vijnanamaya = pattern-recognition, Anandamaya = baseline-coherence. 'We don't connect mind to mind; we connect kosha to kosha.'

resources.title: Tuning the Teacher's Craft — The Cosmology of Sound
resources.summary: Tuning practice through mantra, awareness and neuro-resonance; 'the map so far' — the koshas as a practical framework (scale, density and function of each sheath, from ~2-metre physical to effectively-infinite causal).

resources.title: Los 5 Koshas del Ser
resources.summary: Single-image overview of the five koshas of being — the layered map at a glance.

resources.title: Modelo Koshas — Metáfora del Automóvil
resources.summary: The Session 1 car metaphor as a diagram: Annamaya as the chassis, Pranamaya the transmission, Manomaya the alert dashboard — the koshas as a practical energy-management system.

resources.title: La Resonancia de la Conexión
resources.summary: Session 3 visual on sound, resonance and connection — how vibration organizes and links the sheaths.

resources.title: Cómo integrar tus cinco koshas
resources.summary: Single-narrator ES recap of the final integration session: tuning each kosha with its mantra (Mahāmṛtyuñjaya, Gayatri, the 32 names of Durga), the laghoo cleanse + yoga nidra, antarmona meditation, and the table metaphor for living all five layers.

resources.title: Maneja tu energía con los cinco koshas
resources.summary: Single-narrator ES recap of Session 1's car metaphor: the koshas as a vehicle — Annamaya the chassis, Pranamaya the transmission, Manomaya the dashboard — a practical system for regulating daily energy.

resources.title: Reprograma tu interior con los cinco koshas
resources.summary: Two-host ES dialogue (Voz 1 / Voz 2) reviewing the first three sessions: the koshas as interactive energy fields (the dark-road/leopard analogy), the body as chassis, prana as engine — reprogramming the inner layers.

resources.title: El sonido que organiza la materia (Sesión 3)
resources.summary: Two-host ES dialogue (Voz 1 / Voz 2) on Session 3: how sound and mantra organize matter and attention — resonance as the connective tissue of the sheaths.

resources.title: Knowledge graph (interactive map)
resources.summary: The flagship interactive D3 map of the whole series — 77 nodes of koshas concepts, mantras, practices and sessions, with session/layout/language toggles and audio-deep-link citations.

resources.title: Transcripts & notes
resources.summary: Searchable transcript portal for all four sessions — verbatim, timestamped, multilingual, with per-session notes.
